component: DB view row-count diagnostic and caller order

quotes.text: it is not safe to call AdjustRowCount() when you have a selection

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: AdjustRowCount checks that there is no selection before notifying its trees of a nonzero row-count change. The inspected search-view sort caller saves and clears selection before this call and restores it afterward. The historical save-to-safe change corrects only the assertion text; it does not add a guard, alter the predicate or prove runtime safety.
title: AdjustRowCount documents its selection constraint before tree notifications
